squat_back: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width
Break at hips and knees together
squat_front: Bar on front of shoulders, elbows high
Stay tall — chest up the whole way
Sit straight down between your heels
squat_goblet: Hold the weight at your chest
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
Push the floor away to stand
squat_bw: Reach arms forward as you sit back
Go as low as you can with a flat back
squat_hack: Back and shoulders flat on the pads
Don't lock knees hard at the top
deadlift: Flat back, chest up, arms long
Push the floor away; bar stays on legs
rdl: Soft knees, push hips straight back
Bar slides down close to the legs
good_morning: Band or weight across upper back
Stop at a deep hamstring stretch
kb_swing: Hike the bell back between your legs
Snap hips forward — arms just guide
Brace abs and squeeze glutes at the top
lunge: Lower until back knee nearly touches
Front knee stays over the foot
split_squat: Rear foot laces-down on the bench
Most weight on the front leg
Drive up through the front heel
leg_press: Back and hips flat on the seat
leg_ext: Knee lined up with the machine pivot
leg_curl_seated: Knee lined up with the pivot
calf_raise: Balls of feet on the platform
Lower heels for a full stretch
hip_thrust: Upper back on the bench edge
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
Squeeze glutes hard at the top
glute_bridge: Feet flat, close to your hips
Lift until body is a straight line
back_ext: Pad just below the hip bones
Hinge down with a flat back
Rise until body is in line
adduction: Sit tall against the back pad
Pads on the inside of the knees
abduction: Sit tall against the back pad
Pads on the outside of the knees
floor_press: Lie with knees bent, feet flat
Lower until upper arms touch the floor
fly_lying: Slight bend in the elbows, keep it fixed
Open arms wide in an arc
Hug back up over the chest
pec_deck: Seat so handles are at chest height
overhead_press: Start at the front of the shoulders
Finish over the middle of your feet
pushup: Hands under shoulders, body in a line
Lower chest to just above the floor
pike_pushup: Hips high in an upside-down V
Lower the top of your head toward the floor
dips: Start with arms straight, shoulders down
Lower until upper arms are parallel
pull_apart: Pull the band apart to your chest
face_pull: Pull to your forehead, elbows high
Rotate hands back at the end
shrug: Arms straight, weight at your sides
preacher_curl: Curl up, keep upper arms down
pushdown: Push down until arms are straight
pullup: Hang with straight arms, shoulders down
Pull elbows down to your ribs
pullup_assisted: Pull elbows down to your ribs
pulldown: Pull bar to upper chest, elbows down
pulldown_kneel: Pull elbows down to your sides
one_arm_row: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back
Pull the weight to your hip
chest_row: Pull handles back to your sides
hanging_leg_raise: Lift legs with abs, not momentum
Raise to hip height or higher
dead_bug: Lower back pressed to the floor
russian_twist: Move from the ribs, not just arms
Feet down to make it easier
pallof: Press straight out from the chest
copenhagen: Lift hips into a straight line

tips.smith_bench: Set the safeties just above chest height.
tips.smith_squat: Feet slightly in front of the bar.
tips.kb_press: Wrist straight, bell resting on the forearm.
tips.db_floor_press: Great when you have no bench.
tips.kb_row: One side at a time, other hand on a support.
tips.band_good_morning: Stand on the band, loop it behind your neck.
